status: CLASSIFIED — SIX OF SEVEN CLEARED FOR COMMERCIAL REUSE
supersedes: 2026-09-10 revision, which left all seven presets UNKNOWN
purpose: Track whether existing fabric presets/resources may enter reusable commercial proof. UNKNOWN is a blocker for redistribution, not for studying architecture.
method: Trace each preset's referenced texture files to their origin, then record the exact evidence. Nothing here is inferred from filename similarity.

evidence.generator_docstring: Procedural synthesis and zero-loss packing of tileable 4K / 2K PBR texture sets ... Generates the 6 Core Fantasy Fabric Archetypes
evidence.generator_dependencies: numpy + PIL only — no texture library import, no downloaded source material
evidence.note: No README or license file exists beside the textures. Provenance is established from the generating script in the same repository, not from a metadata sidecar.

separately_classified_assets.what: KitBash3D Atlantis props and their textures
separately_classified_assets.detail: prop-harp, prop-fountain, prop-trident plus ~47 KB3D_ATL_* textures. Licensed third-party asset pack. Do NOT present as an original commercial sample.
Third-party character IP. Appears in the portfolio viewer as an explicit 3rd-party pipeline test. Must not appear in a commercial sample.

consequence_for_the_fabric_listing: The six generated fabric presets ARE clear for commercial proof. That is enough to build the clean-room fabric demo from owner-authored material alone — no KitBash3D, no Melodia characters, no third-party IP.
rules: Record exact source/license before changing UNKNOWN to reusable.
Do not move Melodia-specific or restricted textures into the generic WebGL kit.
When in doubt, create a new owner-authored clean-room material resource instead of redistributing an unclear one.
next_single_action: Build prototypes/fabric-material-lab/ using only the six OWNER_AUTHORED presets.
